subject: Attending CVPR | quick coffee?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Assuming you and the iRobot team might be in Nashville for CVPR this year? Would be great to get a coffee and swap notes on the work we're doing in computer vision / multimodal model dev. 

If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

We'll be at the conference so let me know when works best for you and I can get it booked in! Feel free to swing by our booth (#1123) as well.

subject: [Invite] Encord's CVPR AI Leaders Fireside Chat & Dinner - 06/14
text:
Hi [NAME], 

If you're around for CVPR, I'd love to personally invite you to a small dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat featuring Luc Vincent (former VP of AI at Meta, now Chief R&D Officer at Nexar), followed by a relaxed dinner and conversation with guests from Captions, Woven by Toyota, Pickle Robot, and other leading AI/ML teams.

Here are the details:
Date & Time: Saturday, June 14 at 6:30 PM Location: Moto Cucina (a 15-minute walk from the CVPR venue) Guests: A select group of ~20 CTOs, Heads of AI, and Founders from top AI teams. Confirmed attendees include leaders from Captions, Woven by Toyota, and Pickle Robot. This is an invite-only event for Encord partners and selected AI/ML scale-ups - we hope for it to be a relaxed evening for exchanging ideas, not a sales pitch. If you're not familiar with Encord: we're a data development platform helping 200+ AI teams - including Synthesia, Hudl, and Woven by Toyota - bring better models to market, faster.

Would you be interested in joining us?

subject: Connecting AI Leaders at CVPR – Fireside Chat + Dinner
text:
Hi [NAME],

If you're around for CVPR, I'd love to personally invite you to a small
dinner we're hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We'll kick off with a fireside chat with Luc Vincent-ex-VP of AI at Meta,
Chief R&D Officer at Nexar, and investor/advisor at Encord- followed by
dinner for AI leaders in Nashville on the Saturday of CVPR - we'd love for
you to join if you're interested / can make it!

Attendees are strictly reserved for senior leaders (CTOs, Heads of ML,
Co-founders) from our existing Encord partners and/or other leading AI/ML
scale-ups and orgs - confirmed are Bosch, Toyota Captions and more.

A bit of context on Encord - we help over 200 AI teams improve data quality
for model development. We focus on consolidating data curation, annotation
and model evaluation with the goals of efficiency gains for training
dataset preparation & model iterations.

Let me know if you're interested/free - happy to send over the full details.

subject: Heads of CV Research Evening at CVPR | 14 June
text:
Hi [NAME],

I saw you're attending CVPR this year so I wanted to reach out with an
invite from our co-founders [SENDER] & [SENDER]. They're hosting a dinner and
fireside chat for CV/ML leaders on Saturday (6/14) & would love to welcome
you!

We'll kick off at 6:30pm with a fireside chat featuring Luc Vincent (Chief
R&D Officer at Nexar, formerly VP of AI at Meta) as he reflects on his
career and the toughest challenges still facing teams scaling computer
vision models today.

We hope the evening can be a valuable occasion for you to connect with
others too, so we carrying the conversations over the dinner joined by
Heads of AI from Toyota, Bosch ADAS & Porsche AG, etc.

In case Encord is new to you... we help over 200 AI teams improve data
quality for model development, with the goals of reduce time spent for
training dataset preparation & accelerate model iterations.

Happy to share details if you're in Nashville then?
